subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers adopt or rewrite the linked candidate fix on current main, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or keep this issue parked until a replacement PR owns the fix?
rationale: The issue is valid and paired with an open fix candidate, but the remaining work crosses UI session state and Gateway active-run contracts where a human should choose the permanent repair path.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the recovery intent while aligning composer send/queue behavior with current session-row active-run contracts.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The contributor can update the existing branch against current main and add redacted live Dashboard proof before another review.

options.title: Keep parked behind a replacement
options.body: If a newer proof-positive PR becomes the safe canonical fix, this issue can remain linked there instead of queueing another repair job now.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite can preserve the recovery intent while aligning composer send/queue behavior with current session-row active-run contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main routing signal for the refactored chat and gateway files that a replacement would touch.
